properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured on main): two value sets are published as prose with no enum: add_requirement.provenance (a schema enum, whose annotation already exists and was never attached when the parameter arrived on 2026-09-22) and set_artifact_checksum(s).disposition (a code-only set). 0.78.0's argument check cannot see them, so a call with another problem is told "1 problem — every one is listed" and is refused for the value on the next call. The toolsnap guard missed both because it recognises a value list only when the values are separated by / or |
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-10-05, triaging art:vscode-call-field-log-2026-10-05 (tool surface). Binaries: 0.76.0 and 0.78.0 release builds, and main at e7e304d (reports 0.78.0); scratch stores under the hub session's scratchpad, isolated HOME.

① OBSERVED, the reporter's words (0.76.0): 2026-10-01, "`Validation error on Requirement.provenance: invalid enum value 'user', expected one of [\"authored\", …]`"; and "`set_artifact_checksum` disposition guessed as `design_change`; valid set is design_holds / design_updated / baseline_established (refusal listed them — fine)."

② PRECEDENT: chg:enum-fields-publish-their-legal-values-from-the-schema (2026-09-06) published 38 value sets as enums and added a toolsnap guard. fact:root-cause-a-missing-nested-field-refusal-says-the-schema-publishes-no-description-when-it-does-2026-10-02 left open "whether a `type: string` field documented only in prose should carry an enum" (disposition).

③ CANDIDATES: (a) the values are published and the refusal is complete; (b) the parameters publish no enum, so the 0.78.0 schema check cannot list them; (c) the core refusal is the only check, one call later; (d) the observation is wrong.

⑤ MEASURED on main:
- tools/list: add_requirement.provenance is {type string|null, description listing six values separated by commas}, no enum; add_requirement.priority does carry one. set_artifact_checksum.disposition and set_artifact_checksums $defs.ChecksumAcceptReq.disposition: string, prose only.
- add_requirement {priority: "should", provenance: "user"} → exit 2, "1 problem — every one is listed, so the call can be fixed in one round trip: `priority` …". provenance is not named; a call with priority fixed is then refused (exit 1) for provenance 'user'.
- set_artifact_checksums {accepts:[{…, disposition: "design_change"}], bogus: 1} → "1 problem — every one is listed" naming `bogus` only.
- Code: crates/reflow2-mcp/src/service.rs:1860 RequirementReq.provenance has no schema_with, while enum_schema.rs:89-90 defines requirement_provenance_req/_opt (used for other requests). git log -S puts the parameter at #570, 2026-09-22, after the 09-06 annotation pass. tools/toolsnap.py enum_invariants flags a description only when its values match r"`\s*(/|\|)\s*`"; both descriptions list values with commas.
(b) and (c) hold; (a) and (d) are refuted.

⑥ CLASS: an enum is attached per field by hand, and its guard keys on how the description is punctuated. The 0.78.0 promise "every one is listed" is only as complete as the published enums.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: a full count. A sweep of main's schemas for string parameters whose description lists three or more backticked values without an enum found 29 candidates, most of them prose that names tools. Not each was classified. One adjacent observation, not investigated: seam_coverage {altitude: "galaxy"} answers exit 0 with "0 coupling(s) compared … A ZERO HERE MEANS EVERY COUPLING VISIBLE AT THIS ALTITUDE IS COVERED". Component.level is a free string by design, so no enum is expected, but the reply speaks for a level that does not exist.
